Subject to Company approval and agreement on the complete documentation, we have reflected the $350,000 salary, 50% target bonus, comparable-executive equity and benefits framework, and proposed severance package. We have deleted the blanket non-compete and proposed Cause and Good Reason definitions for discussion. Duties, reporting line, location, commencement date, compensation schedule, and remaining customary provisions must be mutually agreed before execution. edits.text: 1. POSITION. The Executive shall serve as Chief Operating Officer. The Executive’s duties, reporting line, principal work location, commencement date, and any agreed employment term shall be mutually agreed in writing before execution. No relocation requirement or material change to these agreed terms shall be imposed except as provided in this Agreement.

2. COMPENSATION. Subject to Company approval of this Agreement, the Executive shall receive an annual base salary of USD 350,000, payable under the Company’s regular payroll practices and subject to applicable withholding. The Executive shall be eligible for an annual target bonus equal to 50% of base salary, with performance measures, payment timing, and other terms specified in a mutually agreed compensation schedule attached before execution. The Executive shall receive equity participation and employee benefits no less favorable than those provided to comparable executives of the Company, with the applicable comparator group, equity award terms, and benefit arrangements expressly identified in that schedule. Equity awards remain subject to applicable plan documents and required corporate approvals, which shall be obtained before execution for any awards promised in the schedule.

3. TERMINATION AND SEVERANCE. Upon termination by the Company without Cause or resignation by the Executive for Good Reason, the Executive shall receive, in addition to accrued entitlements, (a) 12 months of then-current base salary, payable in substantially equal installments over 12 months under regular payroll practices, (b) a prorated target annual bonus for the year of termination based on days employed during that year, and (c) 12 months of employer-paid continuation health coverage for the Executive and eligible dependents, subject to applicable law and coverage eligibility. The parties shall agree before execution on a lawful equivalent if such health coverage cannot be provided. Severance, but not accrued entitlements, shall be conditioned on execution and nonrevocation of a customary mutually agreed release, with release timing, payment commencement, and applicable tax-compliance provisions settled before execution. Accrued entitlements include earned unpaid salary, reimbursable business expenses, vested benefits, and any accrued leave payable under applicable law or agreed policy. For discussion, Cause means fraud, embezzlement, or material dishonesty against the Company; conviction of or a guilty or no-contest plea to a felony involving fraud or dishonesty; willful misconduct causing material harm to the Company; or a willful material breach of this Agreement. For any curable breach or misconduct, Cause requires written particulars and 30 days to cure. Good Reason means, without the Executive’s written consent, a material reduction in base salary or target bonus opportunity, a material diminution in agreed duties, authority, or reporting status, a required relocation of the principal work location by more than 50 miles, or a material breach of this Agreement by the Company. Good Reason requires notice within 60 days after the Executive learns of the condition, a 30-day Company cure period, and resignation within 30 days after that period expires. These definitions and procedural periods remain subject to mutual agreement.

4. RESTRICTIVE COVENANTS AND REMAINING TERMS. The previously proposed blanket non-compete is deleted. No post-employment non-compete is agreed. Any proposed narrower restriction requires separate express agreement after governing law and enforceability have been evaluated. Governing law, dispute resolution, notices, execution provisions, and any additional confidentiality or other covenants must be mutually agreed and incorporated before execution. This draft remains subject to each party’s client approval and does not constitute a binding agreement.

receiver.message_back: The $350,000 salary, 50% target bonus, comparable-executive equity and benefits, proposed severance, and deletion of the non-compete provide an acceptable basis for final documentation, subject to our client’s approval; we propose that Cause require a good-faith Board determination after notice and an opportunity to be heard, that severance carry no mitigation or offset obligation, and that any release exclude accrued entitlements and indemnification rights. Please provide the proposed comparator group, equity grant economics, bonus metrics, and employment particulars for our client’s review; governing law should be selected once the principal work location is confirmed, and all required Company approvals must be obtained before execution.
